convert_cogview3_checkpoint: convert a CogView3 transformer checkpoint to Diffusers format using the provided checkpoint path
convert_cogview3_vae: convert a CogView3 VAE checkpoint to Diffusers AutoencoderKL format using the provided checkpoint path
run_conversion_script: run the CogView3 to Diffusers conversion script with transformer and VAE checkpoint paths and output directory
swap_scale_shift: swap the scale and shift parameters in a weight tensor for AdaLayerNormContinuous compatibility
push_to_hub: convert and save a CogView3 model to Diffusers format and push it to the Hugging Face Hub
